method: Exact SHA-256 checked original PE table reads plus bounded original objdump instructions; no game execution.

field_evidence.enemy_name_id: Guardian label 1454a9f58..1454a9fb2 reads record+20 id and record+10/+18 name.
field_evidence.enemy_model_scale: Entity creation caller1454c24f8..1454c252a passes record+24 model and record+28 scale.
field_evidence.boss_hp_knots: 1454efa7f..1454efa92 passes boss-table start and start+1b8. 14552b760 skips record byte+54==1 and copies +40/+44 time/HP pairs.
field_evidence.enemy_cast: Raw first16 bytes retained; variant and semantic interpretation belong to guardian actor reconstruction.
field_evidence.raw_fields: Offsets named raw retain their exact source values without assigning unrecovered original field names.
field_evidence.guardian_placement: Run initializer1454b07c0 reads zone+38/+40 as keyed16-byte XY points, +48/+50 as naxx enemy indexes, +0/+4 as radius override, and +d4 as placement angle. Its REA dossier and interpretation are owned by guardian AI recovery.

limitations: These are current target data and instruction consumers, not an independent runtime parity check.
Underlying enemies and boss schedules are different source records; guardian slots select enemy indexes at runtime.
Keyed guardian XY points are provided only where present in the selected table. Missing slots use the separately recovered terrain-aware placement algorithm.
Raw field names intentionally do not assert semantic meanings or native Rust type names.
The normal source build uses generated constants and never requires the reference EXE.
